description: This source file defines the ModuleEmbeddedFileProvider class, a custom implementation of IFileProvider that provides access to embedded files within module assemblies in the OrchardCore framework.

classes.name: ModuleEmbeddedFileProvider
classes.description: A custom implementation of IFileProvider that serves embedded files from module assemblies in OrchardCore.

methods.name: GetDirectoryContents
methods.description: Returns directory contents based on the provided subpath, handling root, 'Areas', and module-specific paths.

methods.name: GetFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves file information for a given subpath, serving physical files for the application's own module or embedded files from other modules.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Returns a change token for monitoring changes; currently returns a singleton null token.

methods.name: NormalizePath
methods.description: Converts backslashes to forward slashes, trims slashes, and normalizes double slashes in paths.
